examples.description: Put an uploaded clip on the main track as the second scene

description: Append an uploaded video or image asset to the main track as a finished scene, or insert it at at_index. Assets longer than 10 minutes become consecutive scenes. A video with no measured length lands as one untrimmed 5s scene marked length_estimated: true, here and in get_composition, until the file is measured in the studio editor. Audio assets are refused; use add_audio_to_timeline.

asset_id.description: A video or image asset id (vas_...) from get_composition's assets list.

at_index.description: 0-based position in scene order; appends when omitted.

project_id.description: The studio project (vp_…) this tool acts on.

name: studio.add_scene_from_asset
